treatment.policy: For each declaration date, select up to two active common stocks using the latest complete Massive reference-asof snapshot no later than declaration_date. Require a positive USD cash_amount, no same-ticker positive USD declaration during the prior 1095 days with full source coverage, exactly 20 pre-declaration bars, trailing-20 median dollar volume at least $1,000,000, and reference close at least $3. Rank only by descending trailing-20 median dollar volume, de-duplicate to one ticker-date decision, then apply the outcome-blind endpoint roster rule frozen in the endpoint preflight: remove exactly its five named void keys before reading any price magnitude or return. Enter each of the remaining 89 rows at the next regular-session open, exit at the tenth subsequent session close, apply repository round-trip costs on a fixed $4,000 research notional, and report double-cost stress. Distribution type, frequency, ex-date price behavior, split-adjusted amounts, historical adjustment factors, post-declaration prices, and outcomes are forbidden selection inputs.

replacement_value_comparator: Use the one actual same-date cash-feasible core slot's identical next-open-to-10-session costed value at most once for the first frozen treatment slot when present and not the same ticker; use zero-return cash for every unmatched or additional slot and for a same-ticker collision. SPY and QQQ are secondary comparators and never replace the primary hurdle.
